import React from 'react' import { Card, CardBody } from 'reactstrap' import { Link } from 'react-router-dom' import "./tour-card.css" import calculateAvgRating from '../utils/avgRating' const TourCard = ({ tour }) => { const { _id, title, city, photo, price, featured, reviews } = tour const id = _id || tour.id const { totalRating, avgRating } = calculateAvgRating(reviews); return (
{featured && Featured}
{city} {avgRating === 0 ? null : avgRating} {totalRating === 0 ? ( "not rated" ) : ( ({reviews.length}) ) }
{title}
${price} /per person
) } export default TourCard
